name: Hip Flexor Stretch
description: Stretches the front of the hip: kneel on one knee with the other foot forward, then shift your weight forward with a straight back.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Kneel on your right knee, with a folded towel under it if you like.
Left foot in front, knee bent, left hand on your left leg.
Right hand on your right hip so you don't bend at the waist.
cues: Keep your back straight and your stomach tight.
Lean forward from the hips, not the waist.
You'll feel it in the front of the right thigh.

prescription.note: Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Half kneel
keyframes.cue: Right knee down, left foot forward, hands on thigh and hip.

keyframes.name: Lean forward
keyframes.cue: Shift your weight onto the front leg.
